supabase._comment: Rejected by default via disabledMcpjsonServers in .claude/settings.json. Enable when BMAD picks Supabase as the DB: drop it from that list and set SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN and SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF.

gortex._comment: Code-intelligence graph over this repo. Installed by mise (see mise.toml) and resolved through its shim on PATH; the daemon is started and this repo tracked by postStartCommand, not postCreateCommand — the daemon does not survive a container stop/start. Bare `gortex` also resolves for host users who installed it themselves. Needs no credential and binds no port. See ADR-0014 for what it replaced and why that must not be reintroduced.
